mainEntity.name: How does new construction impact the resale market in areas like Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: New construction can introduce modern amenities and updated designs, potentially drawing buyers away from older resale homes in areas like Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach. This influx of new inventory can create competition, especially for properties without recent renovations. Buyers might weigh the immediate move-in readiness of new builds against the established character and potentially lower price point of resale homes, representing a practical tradeoff in their search.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction in areas like Aventura can increase competition for resale homes by offering modern amenities. Buyers weigh new builds versus established resale properties.
